method: view_image of actual on-disk original and proportional 360/680 PNGs, each at original detail; direct visual inspection, not metadata alone
observedFindings: All four stations and their order remain readable at 360 and 680 widths.
The DNA fragments carry distinct adapter tabs at their ends, and multiple read rows are shown.
Quality-check motifs appear at both sample and computer analysis; no patient, diagnosis, branded platform or obligatory PCR/cluster step is drawn.
limitations: The checkmark is a quality-check symbol, not a guarantee that every dataset passes or establishes a biological conclusion.
The illustration is a common workflow overview; DNA/RNA, panel scope and normalization distinctions remain in the full material cases.
altTextDe: Vier Stationen verbinden Pflanzenprobe, Adapter-Bibliothek, parallele Reads und Auswertung am Computer. Lupen bei Probe und Auswertung kennzeichnen Qualitätsprüfungen.
altTextEn: Four stations connect a plant sample, adapter library, parallel reads and computer analysis. Magnifiers at the sample and analysis indicate quality checks.
